deployment_constraints: Do not append these fields to the current Power Automate HTTP body.
Model owner must freeze exact names, order, data types, allowed values, and missing-value encoding.
Questionnaire wording and answer-to-feature mapping require clinical review before release.
A new feature_schema_version and model_version must be released together.
